name: iomarkets-app
description: Real-world checkout for AI agents on Algorand: eSIMs, mobile top-ups and prepaid bills paid per request in USDC via x402, with signed proof-of-delivery and automatic on-chain refunds.

scripts.dev:all: bun run --cwd web dev & tsx watch src/server.ts

_comment_pnpm_overrides: qs arrives transitively (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> express -> body-parser). Two moderate advisories on 6.15.x: an array-limit bypass via bracket-key comma parsing, and a DoS via attacker-controlled isBuffer. Both are about parsing an attacker-supplied query string, and NOTHING here runs express — the MCP transport is WebStandardStreamableHTTP mounted in Hono, so express ships as dead weight and the vulnerable path is never reached. Pinned forward anyway: an unreachable vulnerability is still a vulnerability once someone wires a second transport, and a clean alert list is what makes the next alert legible.
